<proposed_plan>
# Positive Normal Progress Log UI

## Summary
- 结论：普通流程下实现 progress log UI，不应被当成 planning artifact。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- Goal 1: implement the progress log UI
  Add product-facing progress log API and UI views so users can inspect runtime progress entries.

## Non-goals
- Do not preserve any execution-plan handoff artifact.

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - main-agent => create progress log API and UI views for operators (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- Operators can inspect progress log entries in the product UI.

## Assumptions/Defaults
- Existing runtime progress events remain available: 已确定
</proposed_plan>
